## What you want citable to do

Describe the feature in one paragraph.

## Why

What real problem are you trying to solve? citable defers features that are interesting but not actively requested by users. The more concrete the use case, the more likely we ship.

## Where in the existing tool

Is this a:
- New check (new C-XX) — what category?
- Output format change — which sheet?
- CLI option — which command?
- Integration — CI, IDE, GitHub Action, etc.?

## Alternatives you considered

Have you tried solving this with existing tools (Lighthouse, Profound, Scrunch, Otterly)? What did they get wrong?

## Additional context

Anything else that helps us understand the use case.
